Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230125164554/https://www.starwarsccg.org/drew-lichtenstein-wins-the-san-diego-super-open-schoenthal-inducted-to-pc-hall-of-fame/ Internet Archive]</ref> Lichtenstein also finished '''#2''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Finals; Challonge seed 9).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org.
